versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.1 – No code changes; documentation update only.

- Updated SKILL.md to clarify agent workflow rules and role settings.
- Improved instructions for mounting tools and handling network restrictions.
- Reaffirmed draft-first order process and enhanced user communication guidelines.

🎉 Initial Release (v1.0.0)

  Welcome to Kaifan - The Agentic Food Delivery Platform!
  - Added `kaifan_bind_account` for secure zero-knowledge authentication.
  - Added `kaifan_plan_order` for intent-based meal discovery and safe draft generation.
  - Added `kaifan_confirm_order` for explicit, user-confirmed checkouts.
  - Enabled intelligent allergen warnings and budget guardrails within the sandbox context.
